transcript.text: Hello, this is a call from Mumbai Bank. May I speak with Rakesh Sharma?
Namaste, main Rakesh Sharma bol raha hoon. Aap kaun bol rahe hain? Mujhe English samajh nahi aati. Hindi mein baat kijiye.

Thank you for confirming. I am an automated assistant calling from Mumbai Bank. I am only able to speak in English, but I do understand your request. If you would prefer to speak in Hindi, I can arrange a callback with an agent who can assist you in your preferred language. Would you like to request a callback from a Hindi-speaking agent? If yes, please let me know your preferred time for the call.

Mujhe Hindi mein baat karni hai. Aap mujhe Hindi mein samjha sakte hain? Agar nahi, toh main callback chahta hoon. Kripya mujhe Hindi mein baat karne wala vyakti call kare. Samay shaam ko 6 baje theek rahega.
